name: The Customer Engagement Loadout
tagline: 12 AI staff for support, retention, reviews — plus a complete owned website chatbot stack.
heroHeadline: 12 AI customer staff + your own website chatbot.

What if every angry customer email, every public review, every refund request, every cancellation conversation had a specialist AI ready to draft the response — calibrated for the actual moment, not a template?

faqs.q: Do I need to know anything about AI or coding?
faqs.a: For the chatbot agent specifically, you'll need to copy-paste some code into Cloudflare Workers — but no actual coding skill required. Setup guide has screenshots. Most users have the chatbot live in 45 minutes. For the other 11 agents, you just chat with them in Claude.ai.

faqs.q: What's the running cost of the chatbot once it's installed?
faqs.a: Claude Haiku 4.5 via your Anthropic API key is roughly $1 per 1,000 messages. At 1,000 chats/month, you spend ~$12/year vs $228-1,188 for SaaS chatbots like Chatbase, Tidio, or Intercom Fin. The Cloudflare Worker proxy is free at typical small-business volume.

faqs.q: What platforms does the chatbot work with?
faqs.a: Any website that lets you add HTML. WordPress (via plugin or theme), Webflow (Embed component), Squarespace (Code Block), Shopify (theme.liquid), custom sites (paste before </body>). Setup instructions per platform included.

faqs.q: Will my chatbot hallucinate / make up information?
faqs.a: The agent ships with strong guardrails — refusal patterns for off-topic, deferral for unknown questions, no inventing of policies / discounts / promises. You also define what's off-limits in the system prompt. Misbehaviour is structurally minimised but no chatbot is perfect — the testing checklist in the kit catches the edge cases.

faqs.q: Does this work for B2B / SaaS / e-commerce / [my industry]?
faqs.a: Yes. The agents are calibrated for customer engagement work universally — SaaS, e-com, agencies, services, anything customer-facing. The chatbot agent specifically asks for your business context and tunes to it.

faqs.q: What if I already use Chatbase / Tidio / Intercom?
faqs.a: Many buyers run this in parallel for 2-4 weeks, then cancel their SaaS subscription once they've confirmed the owned version performs as well or better. The cost differential pays for the kit in 1-3 months for most businesses.
